topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I was going through my emails, and there it was—an unexpected surprise. My old college application essay, the one I poured my heart into, was featured as an example on the admissions website. The way they highlighted my words, it felt like they echoed beyond the application process, like they truly understood the person behind them. I found myself revisiting the moments I wrote it, the late nights, the edits, the nervous anticipation before hitting submit. Now, seeing it shared with prospective students, it’s more than just an essay; it’s a bridge, a piece of me guiding others on their journey. I can’t help but think, maybe, just maybe, I made a difference.
